## Custom made Sialon and Sintered Silicon Carbide Products
Sialon is a silicon nitride based ceramic material with excellent thermal and mechanical properties for high performance industrial applications.
[Sialon Ceramics Denmark ApS](https://sialon.com/about-us/) develops and manufactures innovative ceramic materials, including **Sialon ceramics** , **sintered silicon carbide (SIC) ceramic** and our proprietary sialon **aluminium immersion heater.**
Sialon ceramics and silicon carbide ceramic (SIC) are key in industries with extreme conditions such as metallurgy and aerospace. The corrosion and [thermal shock resistance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thermal_shock) of our aluminium immersion heater ceramics ensures durability and stability in harsh operating environments, enhancing its value in today’s industrial applications.
### What is Sialon?
Sialon is a high performance ceramic made from silicon (Si), aluminium (Al), oxygen (O) and nitrogen (N). We use aluminium atoms to partially replace silicon and nitrogen atoms to replace oxygen in the silicon nitride lattice. An alloyed structure promotes thermal stability, hardness and chemical inertness. With a [Young’s modulus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Young%27s_modulus) of 345 GPa and a hardness of over 17 GPa, our Sialon ceramics can withstand temperatures up to 1400°C. They are also wear resistant and have low coefficients of thermal expansion for harsh environments.
**Sialon ceramics and SIC ceramic in high-tech manufacturing.**
[![Sialon | Sialon Properties | SIC Ceramic | Silicon Carbide Ceramic | Sialon Ceramic](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20225%20300'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://sialon.com/shop/)Sialon and Sialon SIC ceramic are used in high-tech manufacturing for their mechanical/thermal properties. High temperature and corrosion resistant industries use our [Sialon ceramic components](https://sialon.com/shop/), including metal forming and molten metal handling. Sialon is suitable for semiconductor manufacturing due to its electrical insulation properties. Its low wetting properties against molten metals and non-ferrous alloys increase its usefulness in foundry and die-casting applications. So Sialon’s combination of properties goes where standard materials fail. This underlines our commitment to materials science innovation.
##### **Benefits of Sialon ceramics**
  * Our Sialon ceramics maintain mechanical strength and stiffness at temperatures up to 1750°C.
  * Our materials offer high wear resistance for harsh conditions where typical ceramics fail.
  * With a low coefficient of thermal expansion of approximately 3.0 x 10^-6 K^-1, our ceramics offer thermal shock resistance for rapid temperature changes without damage.
  * In addition, our [Sialon ceramics](https://sialon.com/sialon-ceramics/) are ideal for chemical processing applications because they resist corrosion from most acids and alkalis.
  * Our products offer high hardness (17 GPa) for cutting tools and machining components.
  * Importantly, our ceramics have exceptional electrical insulation properties with a dielectric strength of around 212 ac V/mil for electrical and electronic applications.
  * The non-wetting properties with non-ferrous metals are suitable for molten metal handling equipment.
  * In addition, our Sialon materials are lightweight and durable, providing benefits in areas such as aerospace and automotive where weight reduction is a priority.
  * Our bioinert Sialon ceramics are suitable for medical implants and prostheses.
  * Finally, our ceramics are ideal for space exploration and superconducting applications due to their ability to operate in cryogenic conditions.


##### **Manufacturing process of Sialon Ceramics and sintered silicon carbide.**
Sialon Ceramics Denmark ApS adds sintered silicon carbide (SIC) to our ceramic matrix backbone for improved mechanical and thermal properties.
For homogeneity, we carefully combine silicon carbide powder with other ceramic materials. Compacting this combination under high pressure creates a green body, the precursor to [sintered silicon carbide](https://sialon.com/product/sintered-silicon-carbide-products/). We use novel approaches, including cold isostatic pressing, to achieve uniform component density for precise sintering.
##### [![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20800%20630'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://sialon.com/product/ssic-sintered-silicon-carbide-crucibles/)
**Importance of the sintering process in Sialon ceramics and silicon carbide ceramic**
[Sintering](https://sialon.com/sintered-silicon-carbide/) transforms the green body into a fully densified ceramic. Sintering at around 1800°C in a controlled environment allows silicon atoms to diffuse into the ceramic lattice.
The process binds the silicon carbide particles and strengthens the grain boundaries and fracture toughness. We control the sintering time and temperature to achieve a fine-grained microstructure. This is necessary for the high wear resistance and thermal conductivity of [sintered silicon carbide](https://sialon.com/product/high-temperature-sintered-silicon-carbide-crucibles/).
#### Key applications for Sialon ceramics
  *     * Thermocouple protection tubes.
    * [Aluminium die cast components.](https://sialon.com/product/ceramic-cutting-tools/) for high speed machining.
    * Molten metal handling: nozzles, [rotors and impellers](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-rotor-shaft/).
    * Aluminium immersion heater.
    * Wear resistant coatings for automotive and aerospace components.
    * High temperature furnace components: supports, [tubes](https://sialon.com/product/sintered-silicon-carbide-thermocouple-tubes/).
    * Corrosion resistant liners in the chemical processing industry.
    * Electrical insulators in semiconductor manufacturing.
    * Turbine blades in high performance engines.
    * Biomedical devices: bone substitutes, prosthetic applications.
    * Sialon discs for shot-blasting.

**Sialon ceramics integrated in our aluminium immersion heater**
We use the the properties of Sialon ceramics in demanding applications such as [aluminium immersion heaters](https://sialon.com/product/aluminium-immersion-heater/).
Sialon ceramics are suitable for aluminium immersion heaters due to their corrosion resistance and thermal conductivity.
Such [heaters](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-riser-tubes/) are required for accurate temperature control and heat resistance, and perform better in difficult environments. The low wetting properties of Sialon limit aluminium adhesion, while maintaining availability and maintenance costs.
We continue to innovate the capabilities and applications of aluminium immersion heaters for global industrial needs.

## Sialon Ceramics and Silicon Nitride Ceramics
Contemporary ceramics with greater mechanical, thermal, and chemical qualities are necessary for present-day technology. Meanwhile, sialon and silicon nitride ceramics are hard, wear-resistant, and thermally stable. Combining silicon nitride and alumina gives sialon fracture toughness and oxidation resistance. Silicon nitride’s low thermal expansion and strong thermal conductivity are ideal for high-temperature applications. Aerospace, automotive, and electronics sectors use such ceramics for better engine components, cutting tools, and semiconductor processing equipment. Therefore, they boost performance and durability in hostile settings.
### **About Sialon and Silicon Nitride Ceramics**
#### Sialon Ceramics
Silicon, aluminum, oxygen, and nitrogen make sialon ceramics, sophisticated materials. Sialons are made by replacing silicon and nitrogen atoms in silicon nitride (Si3N4) with aluminum and oxygen. It improves toughness and thermal stability. Sialons may be classified as alpha (α), beta (β), or mixed-phase. Alpha sialons, a single-phase material with great hardness and oxidation resistance at high temperatures, are employed in severe wear applications.
[Beta sialons](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00170-020-05846-1) suit cutting tools and wear components thanks to their interlocking grain structure, fracture toughness, and thermal shock resistance. Mixed-phase sialons balance hardness and toughness for high-temperature applications while combining alpha and beta characteristics.
#### [![Sialon Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramic SI3N4 | Silicon Nitride Ceramics Properties | Silicon Nitride Ceramic](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20300%20236'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-riser-tubes/)
#### Silicon Nitride Ceramics
High-performance silicon nitride ceramics (Si3N4) are silicon and nitrogen-based. These silicon nitride ceramics are noteworthy for high strength, fracture toughness properties, thermal stability, and oxidation resistance. Silicon nitride is reaction-bonded, sintered, or hot-pressed. Nitriding silicon powder compacts into porous, resistant reaction-bonded silicon nitride (RBSN). Sintered silicon nitride (SSN) produces dense ceramics with higher mechanical characteristics for bearing and turbine components while sintering yttria or alumina. Hot-pressed silicon nitride (HPSN) is fabricated while applying heat and pressure simultaneously. It is a dense ceramic with unusual mechanical strength and thermal conductivity for high-performance engine components and electronic substrates.
#### Sintering Processes
##### Sintering of Silicon Nitride Ceramics
Green bodies are densified into a strong structure during silicon nitride (Si3N4) ceramic sintering. To avoid decomposition, pressureless [sintering](https://sialon.com/sintered-silicon-carbide/) may happen in nitrogen at 1750°C-1850°C. Gas pressure sintering (GPD) increases densification while applying nitrogen gas pressure up to 10 MPa. It can lower sintering temperatures to 1700°C and reach near-theoretical density. Hot isostatic pressing (HIP) increases mechanical qualities by combining high temperatures (1600°C-1800°C) with isostatic gas pressure (100-200 MPa). Sintering temperature, pressure, and environment must be regulated for better grain growth, mechanical strength, and lower porosity.
#### Sintering of Sialon Ceramics
In sintering β′-sialon ceramics, there are parallels to silicon nitride but also variances. Although both use high-temperature sintering, sialons might need Y2O3 and MgO to form liquid phases and increase densification. The additives may decrease the sintering temperature to 1600°C-1750°C and generate a transient liquid phase. It dissolves and reprecipitates grains for homogeneous microstructure growth. The dissolution-diffusion-reprecipitation sintering process affects grain size and shape. Microstructural control boosts fracture toughness and wear resistance. As a result, it renders additives and sintering settings vital for high-performance sialon ceramics.
#### Applications of Sialon and Silicon Nitride Ceramics
**General Applications**
High hardness, wear resistance properties, and temperature stability render sialon and silicon nitride ceramics (Si3n4) ideal for cutting tools and abrasives. Sialon ceramics keep cutting tools sharp at high speeds and temperatures. Consequently, it minimizes tool replacement frequency. Silicon nitride promotes productivity in high-speed cast iron and hard steel machining. Automotive engine parts and turbochargers need these ceramics. Its low thermal expansion and potent thermal shock resistance are durable in brutal situations. High wear resistance, low friction, and broadened service life increase industrial equipment bearings and rollers for lower upkeep expenses.

#### Specific Applications in Molten Non-Ferrous Industry
Given their thermal shock and chemical resilience, sialon and silicon nitride ceramic (Si3N4) can handle molten non-ferrous metals. In adverse circumstances, these materials resist breaking from abrupt temperature fluctuations. Ceramic [thermocouple sheaths](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-thermocouple-protection-tubes/) provide process control with reliable temperature measurements. [Riser tubes](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-riser-tubes/) and [rotor shafts](https://sialon.com/product/sialon-rotor-shaft/) made of sialon or silicon nitride limit contamination and preserve molten metal handling. Their low molten metal wettability and strong mechanical strength decrease casting timeout and enhance efficiency.
#### In-Depth Focus: Molten Non-Ferrous Industry
##### Challenges in the Molten Non-Ferrous Industry
Molten non-ferrous activities may face temperatures beyond 1000°C and reactive metals that are very corrosive. Such conditions accelerate graphite and alumina degradation, prompting frequent replacements and greater unavailability. These settings also need materials that endure fast heat cycling and grave chemical reactions. Novel materials with higher thermal stability, corrosion resistance, and mechanical strength are necessary for component efficiency and life.
#### Role of Sialon and Silicon Nitride Ceramics
The molten non-ferrous sector benefits from sialon and silicon nitride ceramics. In particular, [sialon](https://sialon.com/) ceramics have potent thermal shock resistance, 17.37 ± 0.48 GPa hardness, and chemical stability in extreme situations. Silicon nitride ceramics are durable under thermal stress thanks to their low thermal expansion coefficients (3.27×10(-6) °C) and good fracture toughness properties. Such ceramics generate silicon oxynitride layers that inhibit oxidation, unlike graphite, which oxidizes at high temperatures. It makes them last longer and needs less care than standard materials.
[![Sialon Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramic SI3N4 | Silicon Nitride Ceramics Properties | Silicon Nitride Ceramic](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20300%20236'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://sialon.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Silicon-Nitride-Ceramics-2.png)
##### Key Components and Their Functions
Silicon nitride thermocouple sheaths shield temperature sensors in molten metal baths. They provide accurate readings and sensor life. Plus, sialon ceramics’ thermal and mechanical resilience helps riser tubes. They are key to low-pressure die casting, retaining performance and shape at high temperatures, decreasing casting faults, and increasing production efficiency. Silicon nitride rotor shafts in [aluminum refining](http://www.adtechamm.com/aluminium-refining-process/) are confronted with constant molten metal and corrosive fluxes and resist oxidation and wear. They cut repair expenses and improve process reliability.
#### Future Trends and Innovations
##### Advancements in Sintering Techniques
Newer advances in sialon and silicon nitride ceramic sintering refine additives and aids for better material characteristics. Rare earth oxides, including yttria and ytterbia, promote densification and microstructural uniformity. They promote grain boundary phase development and decrease sintering temperature for greater fracture toughness and thermal stability. Improvements in pressureless sintering and spark plasma sintering (SPS) provide precise microstructural control. Subsequently, it may culminate in ultra-fine grain sizes below 200 nm in ceramics. Shorter sintering periods lower grain formation and enhance hardness and wear resistance.
[![Sialon Blast Wheel Disc 300 mm | Sialon Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramics | Silicon Nitride Ceramic SI3N4 | Silicon Nitride Ceramics Properties | Silicon Nitride Ceramic](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20225%20300'%3E%3C/svg%3E)](https://sialon.com/shop/)
##### Emerging Applications of Silicon Nitride Ceramic
Silicon and silicon nitride ceramic (si3n4) are entering biomedical and electronic uses. Silicon nitride’s biocompatibility and anti-bacterial qualities render it a better biomedical implant for spinal fusion and dental implants. Due to their high thermal conductivity (up to [85 W/m•K](https://www.ceramic-science.com/php/article_pdf.php?article_id=100499&hash=a2f6d0275a)) and electrical insulation, such ceramics are employed for high-frequency, high-temperature components in electronics. Their resistance to thermal shock and mechanical wear strengthens component future and performance in high-efficiency turbine blades and solar cell substrates, which the renewable energy industry is investigating. Their adaptability renders them attractive candidates for important roles in radical technology. Hence, it predicts major progress in these creative applications.

## Custom made Sialon and Sintered Silicon Carbide Products
### Our Mission
At Sialon Ceramics Ltd we pride ourselves on being a specialist manufacturer of high quality and durable [Silicon Nitride](https://sialon.com/sialon-ceramics/), syalon and sintered silicon carbide Technical Ceramics. Our primary aim is to exceed our customers’ expectations by providing them with exceptional Sialon & Sintered Silicon Carbide consumables, most of which are available from stock, and even if not, we guarantee a maximum lead time of four weeks.
Our ceramic company has a 38 year history of excellence in the global non-ferrous and chemical industries. We are proud of our heritage and strive to live up to it by providing an unparalleled and unwavering commitment to our customers around the world.
We are committed to continually improving and upgrading our state-of-the-art product range to provide our customers with the best resources in the industry. We ensure that we maintain the highest standards of quality so that our customers can rely on our products with complete confidence.
With a dedicated focus on improving our services, we take responsibility for meeting our customers’ requirements and going above and beyond to make a real difference in the industry.

## Изделия от сиалон и синтериран силициев карбид, изработени по поръчка
### Нашата мисия
В „Sialon Ceramics Ltd“ се гордеем с това, че сме специализиран производител на висококачествена и издръжлива техническа керамика [от силициев нитрид](https://sialon.com/bg/sialon-ceramics/), сиалон и синтериран силициев карбид. Нашата основна цел е да надминем очакванията на клиентите си, като им предоставяме изключителни консумативи от сиалон и синтериран силициев карбид, повечето от които са налични на склад, а дори и да не са, гарантираме максимален срок на доставка от четири седмици.
Нашата компания за керамични изделия има 38-годишна история на отлични постижения в световната цветнометална и химическа промишленост. Гордеем се с нашето наследство и се стремим да го оправдаем, като показваме безпрецедентна и непоколебима ангажираност към нашите клиенти по целия свят.
Ние се стремим към непрекъснато усъвършенстване и обновяване на нашата гама от най-съвременни продукти, за да предоставим на клиентите си най-добрите ресурси в бранша. Гарантираме спазването на най-високите стандарти за качество, така че клиентите ни да могат да разчитат на нашите продукти с пълна увереност.
С целенасочени усилия за подобряване на нашите услуги, поемаме отговорността да отговорим на изискванията на нашите клиенти и да надхвърлим очакванията им, за да постигнем реална промяна в бранша.

Sialon Ceramics Ltd – От 1986 г.
Като компания за керамика се стремим да предлагаме най-високо качество на всичките си [продукти](https://sialon.com/bg/shop/). Екипът ни в „Sialon ceramics“ се стреми да предоставя изключително обслужване на нашите клиенти и да гарантира, че те са напълно доволни от преживяването си.
Стремим се да поддържаме конкурентни цени, без да правим компромиси с качеството.
В същото време се стремим да оказваме положително въздействие върху нашата общност и околната среда. Непрекъснато проучваме и разработваме нови начини за подобряване на нашите продукти и намаляване на въглеродния ни отпечатък.
Нашата визия е да бъдем лидер в нашата индустрия, като предлагаме иновативни и устойчиви решения и винаги поставяме нуждите на нашите клиенти на първо място.
### Нашата визия 
С голямо увлечение създаваме иновативни решения в бранша и се стремим да осигуряваме отлично обслужване на всички наши клиенти.
В компанията „Sialon Ceramics Ltd“ се гордеем с разработването и внедряването на нови екологични технологии, които оказват положително въздействие върху околната среда. Сред последните ни постижения е създаването на нова алуминиева сплав със свойства, сходни с тези на стоманата, благодарение на нашата технология за ултразвуково обезгазяване, уфиняване на зърната и микролегиране.
Непрекъснато търсим начини да внедряваме екологични керамични технологии в нашите проекти, като например нашето устройство с ултракондензатори – решение за съхранение на енергия, предназначено за електромобили и фотоволтаични слънчеви клетки. Екипът ни в компанията „Sialon Ceramics Ltd“ се стреми да бъде надежден и иновативен партньор в бранша и с удоволствие ще Ви обслужваме.

## Výrobky ze Sialonu a slinutého karbidu křemíku na zakázku
### Naše poslání
Ve společnosti Sialon Ceramics Ltd jsme hrdí na to, že jsme specializovaným výrobcem vysoce kvalitní a odolné technické keramiky z [nitridu křemíku](https://sialon.com/cs/sialon-ceramics/), sialonu a slinutého karbidu křemíku. Naším hlavním cílem je překonávat očekávání našich zákazníků tím, že jim dodáváme výjimečné spotřební materiály ze sialonu a slinutého karbidu křemíku, z nichž většina je k dispozici skladem, a i v případě, že tomu tak není, garantujeme maximální dodací lhůtu čtyř týdnů.
Naše keramická společnost se již 38 let vyznačuje vynikajícími výsledky v globálním průmyslu neželezných kovů a chemickém průmyslu. Jsme hrdí na naši tradici a snažíme se jí dostát tím, že našim zákazníkům po celém světě poskytujeme bezkonkurenční a neochvějný závazek.
Zavázali jsme se k neustálému zdokonalování a modernizaci našeho špičkového sortimentu, abychom našim zákazníkům poskytovali ty nejlepší produkty v oboru. Dbáme na dodržování nejvyšších standardů kvality, aby se naši zákazníci mohli na naše produkty plně spolehnout.
S plným nasazením se zaměřujeme na zlepšování našich služeb, přebíráme odpovědnost za plnění požadavků našich zákazníků a jdeme nad rámec běžných standardů, abychom v tomto odvětví přinesli skutečný pokrok.
#### Výrobky ze sialonu a sintrovaného karbidu křemíku vyráběné na zakázku pro odvětví zpracování roztavených neželezných kovů.

##  Keramika Sialon ULTRA™
Sialon Ceramics Ltd – od roku 1986
Jako keramická společnost se snažíme u všech našich [výrobků](https://sialon.com/cs/shop/) dosahovat nejvyšší kvality. Náš tým ve společnosti Sialon ceramics se věnuje poskytování výjimečných služeb našim zákazníkům a zajišťuje, aby byli s našimi službami plně spokojeni.
Snažíme se udržovat konkurenceschopné ceny, aniž bychom slevili z kvality.
Zároveň se snažíme pozitivně působit na naši komunitu i životní prostředí. Neustále zkoumáme a vyvíjíme nové způsoby, jak vylepšovat naše produkty a snižovat naši uhlíkovou stopu.
Naší vizí je stát se lídrem v našem odvětví tím, že budeme poskytovat inovativní a udržitelné řešení a vždy klást potřeby našich zákazníků na první místo.
### Naše vize 
S nadšením vytváříme inovativní řešení v tomto odvětví a zavázali jsme se poskytovat všem našim zákazníkům vynikající služby.
Ve společnosti Sialon Ceramics Ltd jsme hrdí na to, že vyvíjíme a zavádíme nové ekologické technologie, které mají pozitivní dopad na životní prostředí. Mezi naše nejnovější úspěchy patří vývoj nové hliníkové slitiny s vlastnostmi podobnými oceli, a to díky naší technologii ultrazvukového odplyňování, zjemňování zrna a mikropřidávání legujících prvků.
Neustále hledáme způsoby, jak do našich projektů začlenit ekologické keramické technologie, jako je například naše zařízení s ultrakondenzátory – řešení pro akumulaci energie určené pro elektromobily a fotovoltaické solární články. Náš tým ve společnosti Sialon Ceramics Ltd se snaží být spolehlivým a inovativním partnerem v tomto odvětví a těšíme se na spolupráci s vámi.

## Proizvodi od sialona i sinterovanog silicijum karbida rađeni po narudžbi
### Naša misija
U Sialon Ceramics Ltd ponosimo se time što smo specijalizirani proizvođač visokokvalitetne i izdržljive tehničke keramike [od silicijum nitrida](https://sialon.com/bs/sialon-ceramics/) , sialona i sinterovanog silicijum karbida. Naš primarni cilj je nadmašiti očekivanja naših kupaca pružajući im izuzetne potrošne materijale od sialona i sinterovanog silicijum karbida, od kojih je većina dostupna na lageru, a čak i ako nije, garantujemo maksimalno vrijeme isporuke od četiri sedmice.
Naša keramička kompanija ima 38-godišnju istoriju izvrsnosti u globalnoj industriji obojenih metala i hemijskoj industriji. Ponosni smo na naše naslijeđe i trudimo se da ga opravdamo pružajući neuporedivu i nepokolebljivu posvećenost našim kupcima širom svijeta.
Posvećeni smo stalnom poboljšanju i nadogradnji našeg najsavremenijeg asortimana proizvoda kako bismo našim kupcima pružili najbolje resurse u industriji. Osiguravamo održavanje najviših standarda kvalitete kako bi se naši kupci mogli s potpunim povjerenjem osloniti na naše proizvode.
Sa posvećenim fokusom na poboljšanje naših usluga, preuzimamo odgovornost za ispunjavanje zahtjeva naših kupaca i idemo iznad i dalje kako bismo napravili stvarnu razliku u industriji.
#### Proizvodi od sialona i sinterovanog silicijum karbida rađeni po narudžbi za industriju rastopljenih obojenih metala.

## Sialon ULTRA™ keramika
Sialon Ceramics d.o.o. - Od 1986. godine
Kao keramička kompanija, cilj nam je pružiti najviši kvalitet svih naših [proizvoda](https://sialon.com/bs/shop/) . Naš tim u Sialon keramičkoj kompaniji posvećen je pružanju izuzetne usluge našim kupcima i osiguravanju da su potpuno zadovoljni svojim iskustvom.
Trudimo se da naše cijene budu konkurentne bez kompromisa u pogledu kvalitete.
Istovremeno, cilj nam je pozitivno utjecati na našu zajednicu i okoliš. Neprestano istražujemo i razvijamo nove načine za poboljšanje naših proizvoda i smanjenje ugljičnog otiska.
Naša vizija je biti lider u našoj industriji pružajući inovativna i održiva rješenja, uvijek stavljajući potrebe naših kupaca na prvo mjesto.
### Naša vizija 
Strastveno se bavimo stvaranjem inovativnih rješenja u industriji i posvećeni smo pružanju izvrsne usluge svim našim kupcima.
U kompaniji Sialon Ceramics Ltd ponosimo se razvojem i implementacijom novih zelenih tehnologija koje imaju pozitivan uticaj na okolinu. Nedavni razvoji uključuju stvaranje nove aluminijumske legure sa svojstvima sličnim čeliku putem naše tehnologije ultrazvučnog otplinjavanja, pročišćavanja zrna i mikrolegiranja.
Neprestano istražujemo načine za uključivanje zelenih keramičkih tehnologija u naše projekte, kao što je naš ultrakondenzatorski uređaj, rješenje za skladištenje energije dizajnirano za električna vozila i fotonaponske solarne ćelije. Naš tim u kompaniji Sialon Ceramics Ltd posvećen je tome da bude pouzdan i inovativan partner u industriji i radujemo se što ćemo vam pružiti uslugu.

## منتجات مصنوعة حسب الطلب من السيالون وكربيد السيليكون المُتلبَّد
### مهمتنا
في شركة «سيالون سيراميكس» المحدودة، نفخر بكوننا مصنعًا متخصصًا في إنتاج السيراميك التقني عالي الجودة والمتين، مثل [نيتريد السيليكون،](https://sialon.com/ar/sialon-ceramics/) والسيالون، وكربيد السيليكون المُتكلس. ويتمثل هدفنا الأساسي في تجاوز توقعات عملائنا من خلال تزويدهم بمواد استهلاكية استثنائية من السيالون وكربيد السيليكون المُتكلس، والتي يتوفر معظمها في المخزون، وحتى في حالة عدم توفرها، فإننا نضمن مهلة تسليم لا تتجاوز أربعة أسابيع.
تتمتع شركتنا المتخصصة في صناعة السيراميك بتاريخ يمتد إلى 38 عامًا من التميز في الصناعات العالمية للمعادن غير الحديدية والصناعات الكيميائية. ونحن فخورون بتراثنا ونسعى جاهدين للارتقاء إلى مستوى هذا التراث من خلال تقديم التزام لا مثيل له وثابت تجاه عملائنا في جميع أنحاء العالم.
نحن ملتزمون بالتحسين والتطوير المستمرين لمجموعتنا من المنتجات المتطورة لتزويد عملائنا بأفضل الموارد في هذا المجال. ونحرص على الحفاظ على أعلى معايير الجودة حتى يتمكن عملاؤنا من الاعتماد على منتجاتنا بثقة تامة.
انطلاقاً من تركيزنا الدؤوب على تحسين خدماتنا، نتحمل مسؤولية تلبية متطلبات عملائنا ونبذل قصارى جهدنا لإحداث تغيير حقيقي في هذا القطاع.

##  سيراميك Sialon ULTRA™
شركة «سيالون سيراميكس» المحدودة - منذ عام 1986
بصفتنا شركة متخصصة في صناعة السيراميك، نسعى إلى تقديم أعلى مستويات الجودة في جميع [منتجاتنا](https://sialon.com/ar/shop/). ويكرس فريقنا في شركة «سيالون» للسيراميك جهوده لتقديم خدمة استثنائية لعملائنا وضمان رضاهم التام عن تجربتهم معنا.
نسعى جاهدين للحفاظ على أسعارنا تنافسية دون المساومة على الجودة.
وفي الوقت نفسه، نسعى إلى إحداث تأثير إيجابي على مجتمعنا والبيئة. ونحن نعمل باستمرار على البحث وتطوير طرق جديدة لتحسين منتجاتنا وتقليل بصمتنا الكربونية.
تتمثل رؤيتنا في أن نكون رواداً في قطاعنا من خلال تقديم حلول مبتكرة ومستدامة، مع إعطاء الأولوية دائماً لاحتياجات عملائنا.
### رؤيتنا 
نحن نسعى بحماس إلى ابتكار حلول مبتكرة في هذا القطاع، ونلتزم بتقديم خدمة عملاء متميزة لجميع عملائنا.
في شركة «سيالون سيراميكس» المحدودة، نفخر بتطوير وتنفيذ تقنيات صديقة للبيئة جديدة لها تأثير إيجابي على البيئة. وتشمل التطورات الأخيرة ابتكار سبيكة ألومنيوم جديدة تتمتع بخصائص شبيهة بخصائص الفولاذ، وذلك من خلال تقنياتنا الخاصة بإزالة الغازات بالموجات فوق الصوتية، وتحسين حبيبات السبيكة، والخلط الدقيق للسبائك.
نحن نسعى باستمرار إلى استكشاف سبل لدمج تقنيات السيراميك الصديقة للبيئة في مشاريعنا، مثل جهاز المكثف الفائق الذي ننتجه، وهو حل لتخزين الطاقة مصمم خصيصًا للسيارات الكهربائية والخلايا الشمسية الكهروضوئية. يلتزم فريقنا في شركة «Sialon Ceramics Ltd» بأن يكون شريكًا موثوقًا ومبتكرًا في هذا المجال، ونحن نتطلع إلى خدمتكم.

## Productos a medida de Sialon y carburo de silicio sinterizado
### Nuestra misión
En Sialon Ceramics Ltd nos enorgullecemos de ser un fabricante especializado en Cerámicas Técnicas de [Nitruro de Silicio](https://sialon.com/es/sialon-ceramics/), Sialón y Carburo de Silicio Sinterizado de alta calidad y durabilidad. Nuestro principal objetivo es superar las expectativas de nuestros clientes proporcionándoles consumibles excepcionales de Sialon y Carburo de Silicio Sinterizado, la mayoría de los cuales están disponibles en stock, e incluso si no, garantizamos un plazo de entrega máximo de cuatro semanas.
Nuestra empresa cerámica cuenta con 38 años de historia de excelencia en las industrias química y no ferrosa mundiales. Estamos orgullosos de nuestra herencia y nos esforzamos por estar a la altura de ella ofreciendo un compromiso inigualable e inquebrantable a nuestros clientes de todo el mundo.
Nos comprometemos a mejorar y actualizar continuamente nuestra vanguardista gama de productos para ofrecer a nuestros clientes los mejores recursos del sector. Nos aseguramos de mantener los más altos niveles de calidad para que nuestros clientes puedan confiar plenamente en nuestros productos.
Dedicados a mejorar nuestros servicios, asumimos la responsabilidad de satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes y de ir más allá para marcar una verdadera diferencia en el sector.

##  Cerámica Sialon ULTRA
Sialon Ceramics Ltd - Desde 1986
Como empresa de cerámica, nuestro objetivo es ofrecer la máxima calidad en todos nuestros [productos](https://sialon.com/es/shop/). Nuestro equipo en la empresa de cerámica Sialon se dedica a proporcionar un servicio excepcional a nuestros clientes y garantizar que estén completamente satisfechos con su experiencia.
Nos esforzamos por mantener precios competitivos sin comprometer la calidad.
Al mismo tiempo, queremos tener un impacto positivo en nuestra comunidad y el medio ambiente. Investigamos y desarrollamos constantemente nuevas formas de mejorar nuestros productos y reducir nuestra huella de carbono.
Nuestra visión es ser líderes en nuestro sector ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles, anteponiendo siempre las necesidades de nuestros clientes.
### Nuestra visión 
Nos apasiona crear soluciones innovadoras en el sector y nos comprometemos a ofrecer un excelente servicio a todos nuestros clientes.
En la empresa Sialon Ceramics Ltd nos enorgullecemos de desarrollar y aplicar nuevas tecnologías ecológicas que tienen un impacto positivo en el medio ambiente. Entre nuestros desarrollos más recientes se incluye la creación de una nueva aleación de aluminio con propiedades similares a las del acero gracias a nuestra tecnología de desgasificación ultrasónica, refinamiento del grano y microaleación.
Exploramos constantemente formas de incorporar tecnologías cerámicas ecológicas a nuestros proyectos, como nuestro dispositivo ultracondensador, una solución de almacenamiento de energía diseñada para vehículos eléctricos y células solares fotovoltaicas. Nuestro equipo en la empresa Sialon Ceramics Ltd se compromete a ser un socio fiable e innovador en la industria y esperamos poder servirle.

## Maßgefertigte Produkte aus Sialon und gesintertem Siliziumkarbid
### Unser Auftrag
Wir bei Sialon Ceramics Ltd sind stolz darauf, ein spezialisierter Hersteller von hochwertiger und langlebiger technischer Keramik [aus Siliziumnitrid](https://sialon.com/de/sialon-ceramics/), Sialon und gesintertem Siliziumkarbid zu sein. Unser oberstes Ziel ist es, die Erwartungen unserer Kunden zu übertreffen, indem wir ihnen außergewöhnliche Verbrauchsmaterialien aus Sialon und gesintertem Siliziumkarbid liefern, von denen die meisten ab Lager verfügbar sind, und selbst wenn nicht, garantieren wir eine maximale Vorlaufzeit von vier Wochen.
Unser Keramikunternehmen blickt auf eine 38-jährige Geschichte von Spitzenleistungen in der globalen Nichteisen- und Chemieindustrie zurück. Wir sind stolz auf unser Erbe und bemühen uns, diesem gerecht zu werden, indem wir unseren Kunden auf der ganzen Welt ein unvergleichliches und unerschütterliches Engagement bieten.
Wir sind bestrebt, unsere hochmoderne Produktpalette ständig zu verbessern und zu aktualisieren, um unseren Kunden die besten Ressourcen in der Branche zur Verfügung zu stellen. Wir stellen sicher, dass wir die höchsten Qualitätsstandards einhalten, damit sich unsere Kunden mit vollem Vertrauen auf unsere Produkte verlassen können.
Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Verbesserung unserer Dienstleistungen und übernehmen die Verantwortung dafür, die Anforderungen unserer Kunden zu erfüllen und mehr zu leisten, um einen echten Unterschied in der Branche zu machen.

## Προϊόντα από σιαλόν και πυροσυσσωματωμένο καρβίδιο του πυριτίου, κατασκευασμένα κατά παραγγελία
### Η αποστολή μας
Στην Sialon Ceramics Ltd είμαστε υπερήφανοι για το γεγονός ότι είμαστε εξειδικευμένος κατασκευαστής υψηλής ποιότητας και ανθεκτικών τεχνικών κεραμικών από [νιτρίδιο πυριτίου](https://sialon.com/el/sialon-ceramics/), σιαλόν και πυροσυσσωματωμένο καρβίδιο πυριτίου. Πρωταρχικός μας στόχος είναι να ξεπεράσουμε τις προσδοκίες των πελατών μας, παρέχοντάς τους εξαιρετικά αναλώσιμα από σιαλόν και πυροσυσσωματωμένο καρβίδιο πυριτίου, τα περισσότερα από τα οποία είναι διαθέσιμα από το απόθεμά μας, ενώ, ακόμη και αν δεν είναι, εγγυόμαστε μέγιστο χρόνο παράδοσης τεσσάρων εβδομάδων.
Η εταιρεία κεραμικών μας διαθέτει 38ετή ιστορία αριστείας στους παγκόσμιους κλάδους των μη σιδηρούχων μετάλλων και της χημικής βιομηχανίας. Είμαστε υπερήφανοι για την κληρονομιά μας και προσπαθούμε να την τιμάμε, επιδεικνύοντας μια απαράμιλλη και αταλάντευτη δέσμευση απέναντι στους πελάτες μας σε όλο τον κόσμο.
Δεσμευόμαστε να βελτιώνουμε και να αναβαθμίζουμε συνεχώς τη γκάμα των προϊόντων μας, τα οποία είναι τελευταίας τεχνολογίας, προκειμένου να παρέχουμε στους πελάτες μας τους καλύτερους πόρους του κλάδου. Διασφαλίζουμε τη τήρηση των υψηλότερων προτύπων ποιότητας, ώστε οι πελάτες μας να μπορούν να βασίζονται στα προϊόντα μας με απόλυτη εμπιστοσύνη.
Με αδιάκοπο ενδιαφέρον για τη βελτίωση των υπηρεσιών μας, αναλαμβάνουμε την ευθύνη να ικανοποιούμε τις απαιτήσεις των πελατών μας και να ξεπερνάμε τις προσδοκίες τους, ώστε να κάνουμε πραγματική διαφορά στον κλάδο.
#### Προϊόντα από σιαλόν και πυροσυσσωματωμένο καρβίδιο του πυριτίου, κατασκευασμένα κατά παραγγελία, για τη βιομηχανία τήξης μη σιδηρούχων μετάλλων.

##  Κεραμικά Sialon ULTRA™
Sialon Ceramics Ltd – Από το 1986
Ως εταιρεία κεραμικών, στόχος μας είναι να προσφέρουμε την υψηλότερη ποιότητα σε όλα [τα προϊόντα](https://sialon.com/el/shop/) μας. Η ομάδα μας στην εταιρεία κεραμικών Sialon είναι αφοσιωμένη στο να παρέχει εξαιρετική εξυπηρέτηση στους πελάτες μας και να διασφαλίζει ότι θα μείνουν απόλυτα ικανοποιημένοι από την εμπειρία τους.
Προσπαθούμε να διατηρούμε τις τιμές μας ανταγωνιστικές, χωρίς να κάνουμε συμβιβασμούς στην ποιότητα.
Παράλληλα, στόχος μας είναι να ασκούμε θετική επίδραση στην κοινότητά μας και στο περιβάλλον. Ερευνούμε και αναπτύσσουμε συνεχώς νέους τρόπους για να βελτιώσουμε τα προϊόντα μας και να μειώσουμε το ανθρακικό μας αποτύπωμα.
Το όραμά μας είναι να καταστούμε ηγέτης στον κλάδο μας, παρέχοντας καινοτόμες και βιώσιμες λύσεις και θέτοντας πάντα τις ανάγκες των πελατών μας σε πρώτη προτεραιότητα.
### Το όραμά μας 
Μας ενθουσιάζει η δημιουργία καινοτόμων λύσεων στον κλάδο και δεσμευόμαστε να παρέχουμε άριστη εξυπηρέτηση σε όλους τους πελάτες μας.
Στην εταιρεία Sialon Ceramics Ltd είμαστε υπερήφανοι για την ανάπτυξη και την εφαρμογή νέων «πράσινων» τεχνολογιών που έχουν θετικό αντίκτυπο στο περιβάλλον. Μεταξύ των πρόσφατων εξελίξεων συγκαταλέγεται η δημιουργία ενός νέου κράματος αλουμινίου με ιδιότητες παρόμοιες με αυτές του χάλυβα, χάρη στην τεχνολογία μας που περιλαμβάνει αποαεριοποίηση με υπερήχους, εξευγενισμό κόκκων και μικροκράμα.
Αναζητούμε συνεχώς τρόπους για να ενσωματώσουμε «πράσινες» κεραμικές τεχνολογίες στα έργα μας, όπως η συσκευή υπερπυκνωτή μας, μια λύση αποθήκευσης ενέργειας που έχει σχεδιαστεί για ηλεκτρικά οχήματα και φωτοβολταϊκά ηλιακά κύτταρα. Η ομάδα μας στην εταιρεία Sialon Ceramics Ltd δεσμεύεται να αποτελεί έναν αξιόπιστο και καινοτόμο συνεργάτη στον κλάδο και ανυπομονούμε να σας εξυπηρετήσουμε.

## Specialfremstillede produkter af sialon og sintret siliciumcarbid
### Vores mission
Hos Sialon Ceramics Ltd er vi stolte af at være en specialiseret producent af højkvalitets og holdbare tekniske keramiske produkter [af siliciumnitrid](https://sialon.com/da/sialon-ceramics/), syalon og sintret siliciumcarbid. Vores primære mål er at overgå vores kunders forventninger ved at levere dem exceptionelle forbrugsvarer af sialon og sintret siliciumcarbid, hvoraf de fleste er på lager, og selv hvis de ikke er det, garanterer vi en maksimal leveringstid på fire uger.
Vores keramiske virksomhed har 38 års erfaring med at levere produkter af høj kvalitet til den globale ikke-jernholdige og kemiske industri. Vi er stolte af vores arv og stræber efter at leve op til den ved at yde en uovertruffen og urokkelig indsats for vores kunder over hele verden.
Vi er dedikerede til løbende at forbedre og opgradere vores avancerede produktsortiment for at give vores kunder de bedste ressourcer i branchen. Vi sikrer, at vi opretholder de højeste kvalitetsstandarder, så vores kunder kan stole fuldt ud på vores produkter.
Med et dedikeret fokus på at forbedre vores tjenester tager vi ansvar for at opfylde vores kunders krav og går langt ud over det forventede for at gøre en reel forskel i branchen.
#### Specialfremstillede Sialon- og sintret siliciumcarbidprodukter til smeltet ikke-jernholdig industri.

## Sialon ULTRA™ keramik
Sialon Ceramics Ltd – Siden 1986
Som keramikvirksomhed stræber vi efter at levere den højeste kvalitet i alle vores [produkter](https://sialon.com/da/shop/). Vores team hos Sialon Ceramics er dedikeret til at yde enestående service til vores kunder og sikre, at de er fuldt ud tilfredse med deres oplevelse.
Vi stræber efter at holde vores priser konkurrencedygtige uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.
Samtidig stræber vi efter at have en positiv indvirkning på vores samfund og miljøet. Vi forsker og udvikler konstant nye måder at forbedre vores produkter og reducere vores CO2-aftryk på.
Vores vision er at være førende i vores branche ved at levere innovative og bæredygtige løsninger, hvor vi altid sætter vores kunders behov i første række.
### Vores vision 
Vi brænder for at skabe innovative løsninger i branchen og er dedikerede til at yde fremragende kundeservice til alle vores kunder.
Hos Sialon Ceramics Ltd er vi stolte af at udvikle og implementere nye grønne teknologier, der har en positiv indvirkning på miljøet. De seneste udviklinger omfatter skabelsen af en ny aluminiumslegering med stålignende egenskaber gennem vores ultralydsafgasning, kornforfining og mikrolegeringsteknologi.
Vi undersøger løbende mulighederne for at integrere grønne keramiske teknologier i vores projekter, såsom vores ultrakondensator, en energilagringsløsning designet til elbiler og solceller. Vores team hos Sialon Ceramics Ltd er dedikeret til at være en pålidelig og innovativ partner i branchen, og vi ser frem til at betjene dig.

À propos de Sialon  Céramique depuis 1986
## Produits sur mesure en Sialon et en carbure de silicium fritté
### Notre mission
Chez Sialon Ceramics Ltd, nous sommes fiers d'être un fabricant spécialisé dans les céramiques techniques de haute qualité et durables en [nitrure de silicium](https://sialon.com/fr/sialon-ceramics/), syalon et carbure de silicium fritté. Notre objectif principal est de dépasser les attentes de nos clients en leur fournissant des consommables exceptionnels en Sialon et en carbure de silicium fritté, dont la plupart sont disponibles en stock, et même si ce n'est pas le cas, nous garantissons un délai de livraison maximum de quatre semaines.
Notre entreprise de céramique a une histoire de 38 ans d'excellence dans les industries mondiales des métaux non ferreux et des produits chimiques. Nous sommes fiers de notre héritage et nous nous efforçons d'être à la hauteur en fournissant un engagement inégalé et inébranlable à nos clients dans le monde entier.
Nous nous engageons à améliorer et à mettre à jour en permanence notre gamme de produits de pointe afin de fournir à nos clients les meilleures ressources de l'industrie. Nous veillons à maintenir les normes de qualité les plus élevées afin que nos clients puissent se fier à nos produits en toute confiance.

## Sialon ULTRA™ Ceramics
Sialon Ceramics Ltd - Depuis 1986
En tant qu'entreprise de céramique, nous nous efforçons de fournir des [produits de](https://sialon.com/fr/shop/) la plus haute qualité. L'équipe de la société de céramique Sialon s'attache à fournir un service exceptionnel à ses clients et à s'assurer qu'ils sont entièrement satisfaits de leur expérience.
Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos prix compétitifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité.
En même temps, nous voulons avoir un impact positif sur notre communauté et sur l'environnement. Nous recherchons et développons constamment de nouveaux moyens d'améliorer nos produits et de réduire notre empreinte carbone.
Notre vision est d'être un leader dans notre secteur en fournissant des solutions innovantes et durables, en plaçant toujours les besoins de nos clients au premier plan.
### Notre vision 
Nous sommes passionnés par la création de solutions innovantes dans l'industrie et nous nous engageons à fournir un excellent service à tous nos clients.
Chez Sialon Ceramics Ltd, nous sommes fiers de développer et de mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies vertes qui ont un impact positif sur l'environnement. Parmi les développements récents, citons la création d'un nouvel alliage d'aluminium aux propriétés similaires à celles de l'acier grâce à notre technologie de dégazage ultrasonique, d'affinage des grains et de micro-alliage.
Nous explorons constamment les moyens d'incorporer des technologies céramiques vertes dans nos projets, tels que notre dispositif de supercondensateur, une solution de stockage d'énergie conçue pour les véhicules électriques et les cellules solaires photovoltaïques. L'équipe de Sialon Ceramics Ltd s'engage à être un partenaire fiable et innovant dans l'industrie et nous sommes impatients de vous servir.

## Prodotti su misura in Sialon e carburo di silicio sinterizzato
### La nostra missione
Noi di Sialon Ceramics Ltd siamo orgogliosi di essere un produttore specializzato di ceramiche tecniche al [nitruro di silicio](https://sialon.com/it/sialon-ceramics/), al syalon e al carburo di silicio sinterizzato di alta qualità e durata. Il nostro obiettivo primario è quello di superare le aspettative dei nostri clienti fornendo loro eccezionali materiali di consumo in Sialon e carburo di silicio sinterizzato, la maggior parte dei quali sono disponibili a magazzino e, in caso contrario, garantiamo un tempo di consegna massimo di quattro settimane.
La nostra azienda ceramica vanta una storia di 38 anni di eccellenza nell'industria chimica e dei non ferrosi a livello globale. Siamo orgogliosi del nostro patrimonio e ci sforziamo di esserne all'altezza, fornendo un impegno impareggiabile e costante ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo.
Ci impegniamo a migliorare e aggiornare continuamente la nostra gamma di prodotti all'avanguardia per fornire ai nostri clienti le migliori risorse del settore. Ci assicuriamo di mantenere i più alti standard di qualità, in modo che i nostri clienti possano affidarsi ai nostri prodotti con assoluta fiducia.
Con una particolare attenzione al miglioramento dei nostri servizi, ci assumiamo la responsabilità di soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti e di andare oltre per fare la differenza nel settore.

### La nostra visione 
Siamo appassionati nella creazione di soluzioni innovative nel settore e ci impegniamo a fornire un servizio eccellente a tutti i nostri clienti.
L'azienda Sialon Ceramics Ltd è orgogliosa di sviluppare e implementare nuove tecnologie verdi che hanno un impatto positivo sull'ambiente. Gli sviluppi più recenti includono la creazione di una nuova lega di alluminio con proprietà simili a quelle dell'acciaio, grazie alla nostra tecnologia di degassificazione a ultrasuoni, affinamento dei grani e micro-legatura.
Esploriamo costantemente modi per incorporare tecnologie ceramiche verdi nei nostri progetti, come il nostro dispositivo ultracapacitor, una soluzione di accumulo di energia progettata per i veicoli elettrici e le celle solari fotovoltaiche. Il nostro team di Sialon Ceramics Ltd si impegna a essere un partner affidabile e innovativo nel settore e non vediamo l'ora di servirvi.

## Produtos personalizados de sialon e carboneto de silício sinterizado
### A nossa missão
Na Sialon Ceramics Ltd, orgulhamo-nos de ser um fabricante especializado em cerâmicas técnicas de alta qualidade e durabilidade, nomeadamente [nitreto de silício](https://sialon.com/pt/sialon-ceramics/), sialon e carboneto de silício sinterizado. O nosso principal objetivo é superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes, fornecendo-lhes consumíveis excecionais de sialon e carboneto de silício sinterizado, a maioria dos quais está disponível em stock; e, mesmo que não estejam, garantimos um prazo de entrega máximo de quatro semanas.
A nossa empresa de cerâmica conta com 38 anos de excelência nas indústrias globais de metais não ferrosos e química. Orgulhamo-nos da nossa tradição e esforçamo-nos por estar à altura dela, demonstrando um compromisso inigualável e inabalável para com os nossos clientes em todo o mundo.
Estamos empenhados em melhorar e atualizar continuamente a nossa gama de produtos de última geração, para proporcionar aos nossos clientes os melhores recursos do setor. Asseguramos a manutenção dos mais elevados padrões de qualidade, para que os nossos clientes possam confiar nos nossos produtos com total segurança.
Com um empenho dedicado na melhoria dos nossos serviços, assumimos a responsabilidade de satisfazer as necessidades dos nossos clientes e de ir além do esperado para marcar uma diferença real no setor.

A nossa equipa na empresa Sialon Ceramics está empenhada em prestar um serviço excecional aos nossos clientes e em garantir que fiquem totalmente satisfeitos com a sua experiência.
Esforçamo-nos por manter os nossos preços competitivos sem comprometer a qualidade.
Ao mesmo tempo, pretendemos ter um impacto positivo na nossa comunidade e no ambiente. Estamos constantemente a investigar e a desenvolver novas formas de melhorar os nossos produtos e reduzir a nossa pegada de carbono.
A nossa visão é sermos líderes no nosso setor, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis e colocando sempre as necessidades dos nossos clientes em primeiro lugar.
### A nossa visão 
Somos apaixonados pela criação de soluções inovadoras no setor e estamos empenhados em prestar um excelente serviço a todos os nossos clientes.
Na empresa Sialon Ceramics Ltd, orgulhamo-nos de desenvolver e implementar novas tecnologias ecológicas que têm um impacto positivo no ambiente. Os desenvolvimentos recentes incluem a criação de uma nova liga de alumínio com propriedades semelhantes às do aço, através da nossa tecnologia de desgaseificação por ultrassons, refinamento de grão e microligação.
Estamos constantemente a explorar formas de incorporar tecnologias cerâmicas ecológicas nos nossos projetos, tais como o nosso dispositivo de ultracapacitores, uma solução de armazenamento de energia concebida para veículos elétricos e células solares fotovoltaicas. A nossa equipa na empresa Sialon Ceramics Ltd está empenhada em ser um parceiro fiável e inovador no setor e estamos ansiosos por o servir.

## Produk Sialon dan Silikon Karbida Sinter yang Dibuat Sesuai Pesanan
### Misi Kami
Di Sialon Ceramics Ltd, kami bangga menjadi produsen spesialis keramik teknis berkualitas tinggi dan tahan lama, seperti [silikon nitrida](https://sialon.com/id/sialon-ceramics/), sialon, dan silikon karbida yang disinter. Tujuan utama kami adalah melampaui harapan pelanggan dengan menyediakan bahan habis pakai sialon dan silikon karbida yang disinter berkualitas luar biasa; sebagian besar produk tersebut tersedia langsung dari stok, dan bahkan jika tidak, kami menjamin waktu tunggu maksimal empat minggu.
Perusahaan keramik kami telah menorehkan sejarah keunggulan selama 38 tahun di industri logam non-besi dan kimia global. Kami bangga dengan warisan kami dan berupaya untuk menjaganya dengan memberikan komitmen yang tak tertandingi dan tak tergoyahkan kepada para pelanggan kami di seluruh dunia.
Kami berkomitmen untuk terus meningkatkan dan memperbarui jajaran produk mutakhir kami guna menyediakan sumber daya terbaik di industri ini bagi para pelanggan kami. Kami memastikan bahwa kami selalu mempertahankan standar kualitas tertinggi sehingga para pelanggan kami dapat mempercayai produk kami dengan penuh keyakinan.
Dengan fokus penuh pada peningkatan layanan kami, kami berkomitmen untuk memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan dan berupaya melampaui ekspektasi guna menciptakan perubahan nyata di industri ini.

##  Keramik Sialon ULTRA™
Sialon Ceramics Ltd - Sejak 1986
Sebagai perusahaan keramik, kami berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan kualitas terbaik pada semua [produk](https://sialon.com/id/shop/) kami. Tim kami di Sialon Ceramics berdedikasi untuk memberikan layanan yang luar biasa kepada para pelanggan dan memastikan mereka benar-benar puas dengan pengalaman berbelanja mereka.
Kami berupaya menjaga harga kami tetap kompetitif tanpa mengorbankan kualitas.
Di saat yang sama, kami berupaya memberikan dampak positif bagi masyarakat dan lingkungan. Kami terus melakukan penelitian dan pengembangan untuk menemukan cara-cara baru guna meningkatkan kualitas produk kami serta mengurangi jejak karbon kami.
Visi kami adalah menjadi pemimpin di industri kami dengan menyediakan solusi yang inovatif dan berkelanjutan, serta selalu mengutamakan kebutuhan pelanggan kami.
### Visi Kami 
Kami sangat bersemangat dalam menciptakan solusi inovatif di industri ini dan berkomitmen untuk memberikan layanan pelanggan yang prima kepada semua pelanggan kami.
Di perusahaan Sialon Ceramics Ltd, kami bangga dapat mengembangkan dan menerapkan teknologi ramah lingkungan baru yang memberikan dampak positif bagi lingkungan. Beberapa perkembangan terkini mencakup penciptaan paduan aluminium baru dengan sifat-sifat mirip baja melalui teknologi degassing ultrasonik, penghalusan butiran, dan mikro-paduan yang kami kembangkan.
Kami terus-menerus mencari cara untuk mengintegrasikan teknologi keramik ramah lingkungan ke dalam proyek-proyek kami, seperti perangkat ultrakapasitor kami, sebuah solusi penyimpanan energi yang dirancang untuk kendaraan listrik dan sel surya fotovoltaik. Tim kami di perusahaan Sialon Ceramics Ltd berkomitmen untuk menjadi mitra yang andal dan inovatif di industri ini, dan kami berharap dapat melayani Anda.

## Skräddarsydda produkter av sialon och sintrat kiselkarbid
### Vårt uppdrag
På Sialon Ceramics Ltd är vi stolta över att vara en specialiserad tillverkare av högkvalitativa och hållbara tekniska keramikprodukter [av kiselnitrid](https://sialon.com/sv/sialon-ceramics/), sialon och sintrad kiselkarbid. Vårt främsta mål är att överträffa våra kunders förväntningar genom att förse dem med förstklassiga förbrukningsartiklar av sialon och sintrad kiselkarbid, varav de flesta finns i lager. Även om så inte är fallet garanterar vi en leveranstid på högst fyra veckor.
Vårt keramikföretag har en 38-årig historia präglad av framgångar inom den globala icke-järnmetall- och kemikalieindustrin. Vi är stolta över vårt arv och strävar efter att leva upp till det genom att visa ett oöverträffat och orubbligt engagemang gentemot våra kunder över hela världen.
Vi strävar efter att ständigt förbättra och uppgradera vårt toppmoderna produktsortiment för att kunna erbjuda våra kunder branschens bästa resurser. Vi ser till att upprätthålla de högsta kvalitetsstandarderna så att våra kunder kan lita fullt och fast på våra produkter.
Med ett starkt fokus på att förbättra våra tjänster tar vi ansvar för att uppfylla våra kunders behov och strävar efter att gå ett steg längre för att verkligen göra skillnad i branschen.

## Sialon ULTRA™ -keramik
Sialon Ceramics Ltd – Sedan 1986
Som keramikföretag strävar vi efter att leverera högsta möjliga kvalitet på alla våra [produkter](https://sialon.com/sv/shop/). Vårt team på Sialon Ceramics är fast beslutet att erbjuda våra kunder enastående service och se till att de är helt nöjda med sin upplevelse.
Vi strävar efter att hålla våra priser konkurrenskraftiga utan att göra avkall på kvaliteten.
Samtidigt strävar vi efter att bidra positivt till vårt samhälle och miljön. Vi arbetar ständigt med forskning och utveckling för att hitta nya sätt att förbättra våra produkter och minska vårt koldioxidavtryck.
Vår vision är att vara ledande inom vår bransch genom att erbjuda innovativa och hållbara lösningar, där vi alltid sätter kundernas behov i första rummet.
### Vår vision 
Vi brinner för att ta fram innovativa lösningar inom branschen och strävar efter att erbjuda utmärkt kundservice till alla våra kunder.
På företaget Sialon Ceramics Ltd är vi stolta över att utveckla och tillämpa nya miljövänliga tekniker som har en positiv inverkan på miljön. Bland de senaste framstegen kan nämnas utvecklingen av en ny aluminiumlegering med stål-liknande egenskaper, vilket har uppnåtts genom vår teknik för ultraljudsavgasning, kornförfining och mikrolegering.
Vi utforskar ständigt nya sätt att integrera miljövänlig keramikteknik i våra projekt, till exempel vår ultrakondensator – en energilagringslösning avsedd för elfordon och solceller. Vårt team på Sialon Ceramics Ltd strävar efter att vara en pålitlig och innovativ partner inom branschen, och vi ser fram emot att få samarbeta med er.

## Özel Üretim Sialon ve Sinterlenmiş Silikon Karbür Ürünleri
### Misyonumuz
Sialon Ceramics Ltd olarak, yüksek kaliteli ve dayanıklı [Silikon Nitrür](https://sialon.com/tr/sialon-ceramics/), Sialon ve Sinterlenmiş Silikon Karbür Teknik Seramiklerin uzman üreticisi olmaktan gurur duyuyoruz. Temel amacımız, müşterilerimize olağanüstü kalitede Sialon ve Sinterlenmiş Silikon Karbür sarf malzemeleri sunarak beklentilerini aşmaktır; bu ürünlerin çoğu stoklarımızda mevcuttur; stokta bulunmasa bile, en fazla dört haftalık bir teslim süresini garanti ediyoruz.
Seramik şirketimiz, küresel demir dışı metal ve kimya endüstrilerinde 38 yıllık bir mükemmellik geçmişine sahiptir. Mirasımızla gurur duyuyoruz ve dünyanın dört bir yanındaki müşterilerimize benzersiz ve sarsılmaz bir bağlılık göstererek bu mirasa layık olmaya çalışıyoruz.
Müşterilerimize sektördeki en iyi kaynakları sunmak amacıyla, son teknoloji ürünü ürün yelpazemizi sürekli olarak iyileştirmeye ve geliştirmeye kararlıyız. Müşterilerimizin ürünlerimize tam bir güvenle güvenebilmeleri için en yüksek kalite standartlarını koruduğumuzdan emin oluyoruz.
Hizmetlerimizi iyileştirmeye özel bir önem vererek, müşterilerimizin ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayı ve sektörde gerçek bir fark yaratmak için elimizden gelenin en iyisini yapmayı taahhüt ediyoruz.
#### Erimiş Demir Dışı Metal Endüstrisi için Özel Üretim Sialon ve Sinterlenmiş Silikon Karbür Ürünleri.

## Sialon ULTRA™ Seramikleri
Sialon Ceramics Ltd - 1986'dan beri
Bir seramik şirketi olarak, tüm [ürünlerimizde](https://sialon.com/tr/shop/) en yüksek kaliteyi sunmayı hedefliyoruz. Sialon Seramik şirketindeki ekibimiz, müşterilerimize olağanüstü bir hizmet sunmaya ve deneyimlerinden tam anlamıyla memnun kalmalarını sağlamaya kendini adamıştır.
Kaliteden ödün vermeden fiyatlarımızı rekabetçi tutmaya özen gösteriyoruz.
Aynı zamanda, toplumumuz ve çevre üzerinde olumlu bir etki yaratmayı hedefliyoruz. Ürünlerimizi iyileştirmek ve karbon ayak izimizi azaltmak için sürekli olarak yeni yöntemler araştırıyor ve geliştiriyoruz.
Vizyonumuz, her zaman müşterilerimizin ihtiyaçlarını ön planda tutarak yenilikçi ve sürdürülebilir çözümler sunmak suretiyle sektörümüzde lider konumda olmaktır.
### Vizyonumuz 
Sektörde yenilikçi çözümler üretmeye büyük bir tutkuyla yaklaşıyoruz ve tüm müşterilerimize mükemmel bir müşteri hizmeti sunmaya kararlıyız.
Sialon Ceramics Ltd. olarak, çevre üzerinde olumlu etki yaratan yeni yeşil teknolojiler geliştirip uygulamaktan gurur duyuyoruz. Son dönemdeki gelişmeler arasında, ultrasonik gaz giderme, tane inceltme ve mikro alaşımlama teknolojilerimizi kullanarak çelik benzeri özelliklere sahip yeni bir alüminyum alaşımı geliştirmiş olmamız yer almaktadır.
Elektrikli araçlar ve fotovoltaik güneş pilleri için tasarlanmış bir enerji depolama çözümü olan ultra kapasitör cihazımız gibi, yeşil seramik teknolojilerini projelerimize entegre etmenin yollarını sürekli olarak araştırıyoruz. Sialon Ceramics Ltd şirketindeki ekibimiz, sektörde güvenilir ve yenilikçi bir iş ortağı olmaya kararlıdır ve sizlere hizmet vermeyi sabırsızlıkla bekliyoruz.

Our ceramic company has a 38 year history of excellence in the global non-ferrous and chemical industries. We are proud of our heritage and strive to live up to it by providing an unparalleled and unwavering commitment to our customers around the world.
We are committed to continually improving and upgrading our state-of-the-art product range to provide our customers with the best resources in the industry. We ensure that we maintain the highest standards of quality so that our customers can rely on our products with complete confidence.
With a dedicated focus on improving our services, we take responsibility for meeting our customers’ requirements and going above and beyond to make a real difference in the industry.
